feeds.title: The Truth About Living With Terminal Cancer
feeds.description: I am JJ Singleton. I was diagnosed with colon cancer on September 4th, 2015. My cancer came back on May 16th, 2017 this time it was metastatic inoperable cancer. I've been fighting ever since. This blog is my journey fighting the cancer.
